: our network, our partners, ourselves. If you're here, you're probably not looking for "just a job." Neither are we. We're driven by impact, and always looking for people who thrive on turning bold ideas into reality. If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who
see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold.

At Powerdot, you'll get freedom
, ownership
, and responsibility
. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

Don't stop reading, the best part's coming up 👇🏼

Why This Role, Why Now:

Powerdot has spent the last seven years building one of Europe's leading EV charging networks: 12,500+ charging points live, 20,000+ contracted, across Portugal, Spain, France, Belgium and Poland. We've moved through the land-grab, the roll-out, and the quality eras.

That shift needs a voice. We're looking for a Head of Communications
to own how Powerdot tells its story, to the market and to our own team. You'll report directly to the CEO and be the person who turns what we do into a narrative that partners, investors, media, talent and our own people actually feel. This is a build role for someone who wants to shape a category leader's reputation from the inside.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

You'll own communications end to end (external and internal) and translate Powerdot's strategy into a story people remember.

Own the narrative:
Define and lead Powerdot's communications strategy across all markets, in lockstep with the CEO and the leadership team.
External comms / PR:
Lead our press and media relations across markets. Build relationships with top-tier journalists, shape the editorial agenda, land the stories that matter, and manage our agency partners in every country to a high bar.
External comms / Social:
Own Powerdot's social presence and tone of voice. Turn our scale, our partnerships and our performance into content that builds reputation and pulls in talent, partners and drivers.
Internal comms:
Design and run how we communicate with our own team across five markets, from company-wide updates to CEO messaging to the rituals that keep a fast-growing, distributed company aligned and energised.
Storytelling:
Be the person who can take a complex, technical, operational business and make it land simply and memorably, in a press release, a LinkedIn post, an internal all-hands or an investor narrative.
Manage and grow the team:
Lead one direct report and orchestrate a network of agencies across all markets, setting the brief, holding the quality bar, and making sure every market tells one coherent Powerdot story.
Protect the brand:
Own messaging consistency and reputation management, and be ready to lead communications when the stakes are high.
Measure what matters:
Bring rigor to comms, share of voice, reach, sentiment, and the link between our story and our commercial and talent goals.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

6+ years in communications, with a blend of PR, social media and internal comms, ideally a mix of agency and in-house, in a scale-up, tech or high-growth environment
A genuine storyteller, you can prove it with work that shifted perception, not just activity.
Hands-on experience running PR and media relations, and managing agencies across multiple markets.
Track record building or running internal communications for a distributed team.
Comfortable operating directly with a CEO and leadership team, and translating strategy into message.
Fluency in English; Portuguese is a strong plus. Any additional market language (Spanish, French, Polish) is a bonus.
Player-coach mindset: senior enough to set strategy, hands-on enough to write the post yourself.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.
You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (last year we went to the Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies, they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. At Powerdot, your voice powers the future, literally.

jobs.title: Finance, Legal, Government and Geopolitical Relations Executive Communications Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description

Finance, Legal, Government and Geopolitical Relations leads communications strategy and execution across a portfolio of critical corporate functions that shape Nokia's business performance, governance, stakeholder engagement and long-term strategic positioning.

The role operates within Nokia's functional GMC model, reporting to the VP, Corporate Communication. The individual will serve as the senior communications partner to three members of Nokia's Group Leadership Team, supporting the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Legal Officer and Chief Government and Geopolitical Relations Officer. The role is responsible for developing and executing integrated communications strategies that advance the priorities of these functions while ensuring alignment with Nokia's corporate narrative, business strategy and reputation objectives.

Working across multiple executive stakeholders, the role orchestrates resources from internal communications, media relations, analyst relations, digital channels and agency partners to deliver high-impact communications programmes and executive engagement activities. Success requires exceptional stakeholder management, sound judgement and the ability to balance competing priorities across a diverse portfolio of strategic issues.

The role serves as a trusted adviser to senior executives, translating complex financial, legal, regulatory, technology and geopolitical developments into clear and compelling narratives for employees, customers, investors, policymakers, media and other stakeholders.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

Executive and Strategic Communications

Serve as the primary communications adviser to the Chief Financial Officer, Chief Legal Officer and Chief Government and Geopolitical Relations Officer.
Develop and own integrated communications strategies aligned with Nokia's business priorities, corporate narrative and reputation objectives.
Translate complex business, financial, legal, regulatory, technology and geopolitical developments into compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.
Develop executive content including internal posts, speeches, videos, presentations, leadership communications and strategic messaging materials.
Prepare senior executives for high-profile engagements, including media interviews, analyst briefings, policy forums, industry events and internal leadership communications.
Ensure consistency and alignment across executive narratives, reinforcing Nokia's strategy, values and long-term business ambitions.

Strategic Business and Stakeholder Communications

Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that support key corporate functions and advance business priorities, reputation and strategic objectives.
Support executive engagement with employees, customers, investors, policymakers, regulators and other key stakeholder groups.
Partner closely with leadership teams to communicate strategic priorities, business performance, transformation initiatives, governance matters and policy positions.
Develop communications approaches that strengthen stakeholder trust, reinforce the corporate narrative and support long-term business success.
Support thought leadership, executive visibility and stakeholder engagement programmes across priority topics and markets.
Monitor developments across business, regulatory and geopolitical environments, identifying communications opportunities and considerations that support executive engagement and informed decision-making.

Resource Orchestration and Ways of Working

Operate within the functional GMC model, drawing on resources across media relations, internal communications, digital channels, analyst relations and agency partners.
Set clear priorities, briefs and quality standards for communications activities across multiple functions and stakeholder groups.
Build strong relationships across GMC and partner functions to ensure communications are coordinated, consistent and aligned with business objectives.
Be willing to operate hands-on, writing, briefing, preparing and executing communications directly where required.

Key Skills And Experience

Extensive senior communications experience within a global organisation.
Proven ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies spanning executive, internal and external communications.
Strong executive communications and advisory skills, with experience supporting senior leaders in high-profile and strategically important roles.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex business, financial, legal, regulatory or policy issues into clear and compelling communications.
Strong strategic thinking and sound judgement.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and navigating sensitive business topics.
A confident and proactive approach to AI.
High personal discretion, sound judgement and the ability to work effectively under pressure and at pace.

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Learn more about life at Nokia .

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

jobs.title: Public Affairs- og kommunikationsrådgiver
jobs.description:
Klima. Natur. Biodiversitet. Grøn omstilling. Fødevaresikkerhed. Erhvervsudvikling.
Nogle af de største samfundsdebatter i Danmark handler om landbruget.

Få brancher er i dag så tæt forbundet med politiske beslutninger. Derfor er behovet for stærk kommunikation, gode relationer og konstruktiv interessevaretagelse større end nogensinde.

Vi søger en Public Affairs- og kommunikationsrådgiver, der kan hjælpe os med at fortælle historierne, skabe relationerne og understøtte de politiske indsatser, der skal sikre gode rammer for fremtidens landbrug. Hos os får du ikke blot lov til at kommunikere om virkeligheden - du får mulighed for at påvirke den.

Hvorfor skal du vælge SAGRO som din nye arbejdsplads?

Vi tror på, at dygtige mennesker skaber de bedste resultater, når de får ansvar og frihed. Derfor får du stor indflydelse på dine opgaver og mulighed for at sætte dit eget aftryk på stillingen.
Du bliver en del af et politisk sekretariat med korte beslutningsveje, højt til loftet og en hverdag, hvor vi hjælper hinanden. Samtidig bliver du en del af en organisation med stærke faglige miljøer og kolleger, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe værdi for dansk landbrug.
Nogle dage sidder du fordybet i en tekst eller en kommunikationsplan. Andre dage står du midt i et arrangement, et dyrskue eller et møde med samarbejdspartnere. Vi lover én ting: Der bliver ikke mange ens arbejdsdage.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

Skrive artikler, nyheder, debatindlæg og andet indhold til både medlemmer, samarbejdspartnere og offentligheden.
Udvikle og drive landbrugets tilstedeværelse på sociale medier samt understøtte public affairs-indsatser gennem målrettet kommunikation.
Bidrage til dialogen med politikere, organisationer, myndigheder og øvrige interessenter.
Planlægge og gennemføre debatter, konferencer, medlemsmøder, dyrskuer og andre arrangementer.
Bidrage til udvalgte kommercielle aktiviteter og markedsføringsindsatser på tværs af SAGRO.
Arbejde tæt sammen med de folkevalgte i ejerforeningernes bestyrelser og udvikle kommunikationsindsatser, der styrker ejerforeningernes synlighed og position.

For at blive en succes i stillingen er det her vigtigt for dig at vide:

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med kommunikation, public affairs, interessevaretagelse eller lignende. Måske kommer du fra en interesseorganisation, en kommune, et kommunikationsbureau eller en virksomhed med samfundsrettet kommunikation. Det vigtigste er dog ikke, hvor du kommer fra, men at du:

Er en stærk skriftlig formidler og har blik for politiske dagsordener og samfundsudvikling.
Kan omsætte komplekse emner til kommunikation, som mennesker forstår og engagerer sig i.
Er god til at skabe relationer og samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker.
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Kendskab til landbruget er en fordel - men ikke et krav. Vi lærer dig gerne branchen at kende, hvis du kommer med nysgerrighed, engagement og stærke kompetencer.

Hør hvad din kommende chef siger om jobbet og om SAGRO:

"Det, der giver mig energi i jobbet, er samarbejdet med landbrugets folkevalgte og muligheden for at skabe resultater gennem stærke partnerskaber og netværk. Landbrugets grønne omstilling og gode rammevilkår er omdrejningspunktet for vores arbejde, og jeg motiveres af at samle mennesker og idéer om fælles løsninger til gavn for erhvervet. Nysgerrighed, relationer og evnen til at bygge bro er afgørende for at lykkes."

Stine Larsen, Chef, Politisk Sekretariat

Hvad får du mere?

Fleksibilitet og balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.
Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab samt faglig og personlig udvikling
Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
Frokostordning.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Stine Larsen, Politisk chef via mail: sbp@sagro.dk eller telefon 40295885.

Arbejdstid:
37 timer
Arbejdssted:
Din faste arbejdsplads bliver med tilknytning til vores kontor i Herning, men dit arbejdsområde bliver hele SAGRO. Vi er til stede i Esbjerg, Billund, Herning, Holstebro og Ringkøbing, og du skal derfor forvente at arbejdsdage, møder, arrangementer og events løbende finder sted på tværs af vores lokationer.

Info

SAGRO er ejet af fem landboorganisationer med tilknytning til Landbrug & Fødevarer og repræsenterer tilsammen tusindvis af landmænd i Vest- og Sydjylland.
Gennem vores Politiske Sekretariat understøtter vi de folkevalgte i ejerorganisationerne og arbejder for at styrke dialogen mellem landbruget og centrale samfundsaktører.
Målet er at bidrage til løsninger, der styrker erhvervet, lokalsamfundene og den grønne omstilling.

Læs mere om vores rekrutteringsproces her: https://job-hos-sagro.dk/om-sagro/rekrutteringsproces

jobs.title: Public Affairs Director, Benelux & France
jobs.description:
Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description:

UPS is hiring a Director of Public Affairs
to lead our government relations and advocacy across Belgium, the Netherlands, France, and Luxembourg. This person will own the public affairs agenda for their markets, shape government relations strategy, and deliver outcomes that protect and enable UPS operations and business growth. This is a hands-on, business-embedded public affairs leadership role with clear ownership across four markets, strong operational proximity, and a mandate to deliver outcomes that matter to a global logistics leader. The Director of Public Affairs reports directly to the Vice President of Public Affairs for the UPS EMEA Region, with a dotted line to the Managing Director for Benelux and France.

What You’ll Do

Assess relevant legislative/regulatory/political developments and stakeholder positions across the West Cluster (Belgium, Netherlands, France, Luxembourg).
Develop and execute advocacy strategies that protect UPS operations, network efficiency, and enable business growth.
Draft and steer high-quality advocacy collateral (briefings, position papers, consultation responses, executive talking points).
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with relevant policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders.
Deliver bespoke analysis of political developments as they relate to UPS business priorities.
Lead UPS participation in relevant trade associations in your markets, assume leadership roles within trade associations and manage cross-functional UPS engagement in these organizations.
Partner closely with internal leaders and operations to ensure government relations strategy is business-aligned. Participate regularly in internal business reviews and contribute relevant public policy context to business strategy development.
Respond to local business needs related to municipal/regional/national government as they arise.
Engage in public speaking and media-facing opportunities where appropriate.

Your experience

15+ years in government relations / public affairs / public policy (corporate, public sector, trade association, etc.).
Experience relevant to transportation/logistics (e.g. transport, trade, customs, sustainability, labour/employment, other related policy areas).
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute comprehensive advocacy strategies with real-world outcomes.
Experience in public speaking/external relations.
Post-graduate education in relevant field e.g. political science/public policy.

Who are you

Self-starter: comfortable with independent ownership, prioritization, and execution of advocacy strategies.
Strong communicator (written + verbal) with excellent stakeholder instincts and commitment to credibility and integrity in all public affairs engagements.
Commercially curious: motivated to deepen business and operational acumen and work shoulder-to-shoulder with operations leaders.

Languages

Professional fluency in English, Dutch, and French is required.

Location and travelling

This role is office-based in the UPS EMEA HQ in Brussels, Belgium.
Some travel required (primarily Eindhoven and Paris), driving license necessary.

Public Affairs at UPS

Government relations at UPS is driven by a dynamic Public Affairs team located across the U.S., EMEA, Americas and APAC regions. The PA Director for Benelux and France will work particularly closely with peers covering other geographies within the EMEA region as well as the dedicated EU policy team, also based in the EMEA region HQ. A career in Public Affairs at UPS provides rewarding opportunities to develop business acumen through operational exposure, as well as international experience working for a global transportation and logistics leader.

How to apply

Please submit your application with an updated version of your CV and a cover letter.

UPS is committed to a policy of treating individuals fairly and recruiting, selecting, training, promoting and compensating based on merit, experience and other work-related criteria. We do not discriminate against any applicant based on age, race, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Jouw nieuwe baan

Als head of content binnen het cluster Public (life sciences & health en onderwijs) heb je een veelzijdige rol. Je stuurt redacteuren aan, ontwikkelt een strategisch contentprogramma, zorgt voor nieuwe digitale concepten en bewaakt de redactionele kwaliteit. Zelf draag je ook bij aan het creatieve productieproces.

Door jouw goede en relevante contentkalender kunnen zorg- en onderwijsprofessionals elkaar vinden en kennis delen. Of het nu gaat om evenementen, online kanalen of andere manieren van verbinden, jij helpt organisaties zich te presenteren en een sterke band op te bouwen met hun doelgroep.

Dit cluster omvat toonaangevende beurzen en events, zoals de Nationale Onderwijstentoonstelling (NOT), IPON, zorg & facility, zorg & food, zorg & ict, zorg & hr
en LSH Next Summit.
Daarnaast hebben we twee online platformen de Dutch Health Hub
en IPON.nl.

Als head of content ben je onderdeel van het cluster MT, met de manager marketing, manager sales en de clustermanager. Samen bepaal je de strategie en de koers voor de toekomst van het cluster Public. Je bent sparringpartner van de clustermanager en CCO en werkt nauw samen met de manager sales en de twee andere head of contents voor het cluster Bouw & Installatie en cluster Tech.

Dit vind je leuk om te doen

Begeleiden van redacteuren en het opstellen en bewaken van de redactionele begroting
Leveren van contentprogramma's voor de beurzen binnen het cluster. Erop toezien dat de inhoud van kanalen en platformen overeenkomt met redactionele uitgangspunten
Coördineren en regisseren van het redactieproces en zelf redactioneel bijdragen
Meedenken over hoe de gebruiker het hele jaar door on- en offline te bedienen
Bedenken en inzetten van vernieuwende contentconcepten voor omzetvergroting
Samen met de clustermanager ben je het gezicht naar buiten, dus op podia staan vind je leuk

Onze waarden bevlogen, duurzaam en vernieuwend zijn voor jou geen loze termen, maar waarden die ook sterk bij jou passen. Dit zijn de pijlers waar jij jouw team op stuurt en jouw resultaten op kunnen worden afgerekend.

Job Requirements

Dit krijg je van ons

Werkplezier en persoonlijke ontwikkeling vinden we belangrijk. Je krijgt veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een open en informele werksfeer met betrokken collega’s, korte lijnen en aandacht voor samenwerking. Daarnaast is er ruimte voor ontspanning, met gezamenlijke activiteiten, borrels en aandacht voor een prettige werkomgeving.

Verder krijg je:

Een maandsalaris tussen €4.714 en €5.387 bruto bij 40 uur per week. In deze rol kun je doorgroeien naar een maximaal salaris van €6.734. Het salaris hangt af van relevante ervaring
8% vakantiegeld, pensioenregeling en deelname aan een collectieve bedrijfssuccesregeling (max. 5%)
Laptop en smartphone (max. €850 budget)

En dit is nog maar het begin. Check al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden hier!

Werken bij Jaarbeurs

Al meer dan 105 jaar creëert Royal Dutch Jaarbeurs ontmoetingen die ertoe doen. In het hart van Utrecht verbinden en inspireren we mensen, markten en ideeën door de magie van live ontmoetingen, fysiek en digitaal. Met ruim 350 collega’s organiseren en faciliteren we live ontmoetingen waarin mensen elkaar inspireren, versterken en verder helpen groeien. Zo ontstaan in een steeds meer digitale wereld waardevolle verbindingen met duurzame impact.

Jaarbeurs wil een divers samengestelde en inclusieve organisatie zijn. Waar ruimte is voor verschillen en waar iedereen zich welkom voelt. Dat helpt ons om de kwaliteit van ons werk te verbeteren. Kandidaten die de diversiteit en inclusie van ons team vergroten, moedigen we aan om te solliciteren. Lees hier meer over onze visie op diversiteit & inclusie.

Wat breng jij mee

Minimaal een afgeronde hbo opleiding en ervaring als hoofdredacteur, contentmanager of senior (eind) redacteur
Een creatieve geest, schrijftalent, een scherp oog voor journalistieke kwaliteit en je denkt en werkt cross-mediaal
Ervaring met het begeleiden en bouwen van een enthousiast redactieteam, met taakverdeling, (capaciteits)planning en budgetten
Kennis van data en AI. Je kunt data analyseren en toepassen in je werk, denk aan het verbeteren van contentstrategieën en analyseren van lezersgedrag
Positiviteit en je weet anderen te inspireren. Je staat met plezier op een podium of voor een groep of begeleidt paneldiscussies
Affiniteit met online- en offline vaktitels of vakbeurzen
Kennis van wat er speelt in de LSH en Onderwijs-branche. Je hebt hier een netwerk en kent de belangrijke spelers en trends

Hebben we je interesse gewekt?

We horen graag van je. Reageren op deze vacature kan via de sollicitatiebutton. Jouw sollicitatie wordt direct doorgestuurd en je kunt snel een reactie van ons verwachten. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Nikki de Coole (recruiter) via nikki.de.coole@jaarbeurs.nl.

jobs.title: Senior Producer
jobs.description:
About Bauer Media Audio Ireland

Bauer Media Audio Ireland is the country’s largest commercial radio group, operating eight stations including national brands Today FM and Newstalk, alongside youth-focused SPIN stations in Dublin and the Southwest. The portfolio also includes iRadio across the Northeast and Northwest, 98FM in Dublin, Beat in the Southeast, and Red FM in Cork.

Beyond radio, Bauer Media Audio Ireland delivers a diverse and innovative audio offering. This includes Off the Ball, Ireland’s leading digital sports brand; GoLoud, a premium platform for radio, podcasts, and music; audioXi, the country’s largest digital audio advertising exchange; and Media Central, Ireland’s leading media sales house.

About the Role

Newstalk is inviting candidates to apply for the role of Senior Producer on our multi-award-winning afternoon show, The Hard Shoulder. Broadcast between 4pm and 7pm, the programme delivers comprehensive news coverage while also providing great company, conversation and sharp analysis for a broad national audience.

We are looking for an experienced producer to bring fresh thinking, editorial rigour and strong leadership to a well-established programme: someone who can grow audience engagement, shape compelling live output and support a high-performing production team.

What You’ll Do

Lead end-to-end daily production for The Hard Shoulder, including editorial planning, running orders, presenter briefings, guest preparation, studio coordination and live output between 4pm and 7pm.
Set and deliver the editorial vision for the programme, using strong judgement, knowledge of current affairs and an understanding of the Newstalk audience to shape distinctive stories, angles and conversations.
Forward-plan across the editorial calendar, anticipating major news developments, cultural moments, listener interests and cross-station opportunities.
Generate, develop and commission original radio ideas, interviews, features, audio pieces and on-air exclusives that feel fresh, relevant and audience-focused.
Use audience insight, listening trends, digital engagement and listener feedback to inform story selection, guest choices, formats and running orders.
Manage, coach and develop researchers, reporters and contributors working with the programme, supporting high standards of accuracy, creativity, initiative and delivery under pressure.
Produce live in studio with confidence, adapting pacing, tone, content and running order in response to breaking news, presenter needs, audience signals, timing constraints and technical issues.
Build a strong working relationship with the presenters and work collaboratively with production, newsroom, digital, technical and commercial colleagues where appropriate.
Book high-quality guests, develop and maintain a strong, diverse contact base, and prepare clear, accurate and engaging briefing material for the presenter.
Research, verify, write and edit scripts, cues, questions and programme material to a high editorial standard across live, pre-recorded, digital and on-demand output.
Ensure all output meets Newstalk editorial standards and complies with relevant legal, regulatory and ethical requirements, including defamation, copyright, privacy and Coimisiún na Meán codes of conduct.
Champion fair, inclusive and representative editorial choices, ensuring a wide range of voices and perspectives are considered in programme planning and execution.
Contribute to wider Newstalk initiatives, campaigns and multi-platform content opportunities, helping the show connect with audiences beyond the live broadcast.

What you'll bring:

An experienced Senior Producer with excellent editorial judgement, a strong grasp of current affairs and a deep understanding of what makes live speech radio compelling.
You can lead complex live output calmly and decisively, making real-time editorial and production decisions while keeping the programme accurate, engaging, legally sound and on schedule.
You understand audience needs and behaviour, and you are comfortable using insight, analytics and listener feedback alongside editorial instinct to grow reach, relevance and trust.
You have strong contacts, excellent guest judgement and the confidence to secure agenda-setting interviews, exclusives and distinctive contributors.

Job Description

The role operates within Nokia’s functional GMC model reporting to the VP, Corporate Communications & Executive Messaging. The role holder works closely with Business Segment and functional communications leads as part of the GMC team. The role holder will draw on other GMC teams, including media relations, internal communications, social, events, marketing strategy, technology marketing and partner marketing to deliver integrated, high-quality communications.

This role serves as the dedicated communications partner to the Chief Technology and AI Officer, providing senior counsel on positioning, messaging and stakeholder engagement. The role holder will bring a strategic lens to the Technology and AI organisation’s communications, shaping plans at the point of design and ensuring that Nokia’s technology story is told with the clarity and commercial relevance.

Given the pace and scale of change Nokia is navigating This role requires someone who is both a strategist and a practitioner with sufficient grounding in technology to engage credibly with the subject matter, and the communications expertise to translate it into narratives that resonate with key stakeholders.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

Develop and own the integrated communications strategy for the Technology and AI organisation, aligned to Nokia’s overall narrative, the GMC priorities and business objectives.
Build and execute a forward-looking communications strategy that anticipates key technology milestones, research announcements, partnership moments and industry events, translating complex technical and strategic developments into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences.
Serve as the dedicated communications partner and strategic sparring partner to the Chief Technology and AI Officer, providing senior counsel on positioning, messaging, thought leadership and reputation.
Develop executive content for the CTAO across speeches, keynotes, op-eds, posts and internal communications, and prepare senior executives for high-profile engagements including media interviews, industry forums, analyst briefings and internal all-hands.
Own Nokia’s Bell Labs communications narrative, ensuring its research and innovation story is positioned as a competitive differentiator and integrated into Nokia’s broader technology and corporate messaging.
Ensure complete integration of Technology and AI communications into the Nokia master narrative and GMC strategy working in close alignment with peers to ensure technology stories reinforce and connect with Nokia’s overall positioning.
Operate within Nokia’s functional GMC model, drawing on other teams to help deliver the plan and setting clear briefs, priorities and quality standards.

Key Skills And Experience

You must have:

Extensive senior communications experience, with a strong track record in technology communications within a global organisation or agency environment.
Strong strategic thinking and sound judgement, with the ability to operate effectively in complex global environments.
Sufficient grounding in technology, including AI, network infrastructure or related fields to engage credibly with subject matter experts and translate complex technical concepts into compelling external and internal narratives.
Proven ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies that span external, internal and executive communications, with a strong instinct for narrative coherence across a complex organisation.
Strong experience as a senior communications partner to C-suite leaders, with the ability to act as a strategic sparring partner, challenging, advising and developing thinking, not just executing.
A demonstrated commitment to integration and collaboration with the discipline to ensure communications plans connect with and reinforce the broader company narrative.
Strong executive communications and content skills, with the ability to write compellingly across formats, from internal leadership messages to keynote speeches and external op-eds.
A confident and proactive approach to AI: using AI to enhance research, accelerate content development, synthesise inputs and increase the overall quality and pace of communications work.
The ability to operate as a senior individual contributor, setting strategy, influencing without authority and delivering personally where required.

It would be advantageous if you also had:

Familiarity with research communications, innovation storytelling or the positioning of R&D as a commercial differentiator.
Background in operating within a matrixed, functional communications model.
Experience managing communications around technology partnerships, ecosystem strategy or platform narratives.
Experience using AI tools to build content repositories, accelerate drafting workflows or support real-time communications planning.

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Learn more about life at Nokia .

Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

Company Description

Continental is a leading tyre manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €39.7 billion in 2024 and currently employs around 95,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Tyre solutions from the Tyres group sector make mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tyres as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tyre manufacturers. In fiscal 2024, the Tyres group sector generated sales of 13.9 billion euros. Continental's tyre division employs more than 57,000 people worldwide and has 20 production and 16 development sites.

Job Description

Drive a Global Brand. Tell Stories That Matter. Shape the Future of Mobility.

At Continental, we believe great brands are built through meaningful connections, powerful storytelling, and unforgettable experiences. As one of the world's leading tyre and technology companies, we are looking for a passionate and creative Marketing Communications Manager
to help bring our brand to life across the UK and Ireland.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic marketing team and play a leading role in shaping how customers, partners, employees, and industry stakeholders experience the Continental brand. From high-profile sponsorship activations and product launches to digital campaigns, events, and customer marketing initiatives, you will be at the forefront of communicating our commitment to safety, innovation, sustainability, and performance.

About The Role

As Marketing Communications Manager,
you will lead the development and delivery of integrated marketing communications across our Passenger Car, SUV, Van, Truck, Bus, and Specialty Tyre portfolios. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for creating compelling campaigns, managing brand communications, developing customer-focused marketing initiatives, and delivering world-class events that strengthen Continental's market-leading position.

You will oversee a talented team while working closely with sales, product management, technical teams, European marketing colleagues, creative agencies, sponsorship partners, and external stakeholders. This is a highly visible role that combines strategic thinking, creativity, leadership, and commercial focus.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Continental's marketing communications strategy across the UK and Ireland.
Act as brand guardian, ensuring consistent and impactful use of the Continental brand across all channels and touchpoints.
Develop engaging campaigns that build awareness, drive demand, and support business growth.
Create compelling product stories that translate technical innovations into meaningful customer benefits.
Manage and activate high-profile sponsorships & partnerships such as the Tour de France, Merecedes-Benz World, England Rugby and adidas.
Lead digital marketing activity including website content, social media, paid campaigns, video content, SEO, GEO, and lead generation programmes.
Plan and deliver outstanding events including product launches, dealer conferences, trade exhibitions, training events, and customer experiences.
Develop customer marketing programmes that support retailers, fleet operators, distributors, and commercial partners.
Manage agency relationships, marketing budgets, campaign performance measurement, and reporting.
Inspire, develop, and lead a high-performing marketing communications team.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a skilled marketing professional who combines creativity with commercial awareness and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

You will bring:

A degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline.
5+ years' experience in marketing communications, brand management, or integrated marketing roles.
Strong experience across digital marketing, content creation, events, sponsorship, and campaign management.
Experience working with both B2B and B2C audiences.
Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to transform complex technical information into clear and compelling customer-focused content.
Experience managing agencies, suppliers, budgets, and multiple concurrent projects.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership capabilities.
Be a strong people‑manager, with the ability to develop, motivate and inspire

Additional Information

Why Continental?

At Continental, you'll have the opportunity to work with a globally respected brand that is shaping the future of mobility. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your work has a direct impact on business success.

This is an especially exciting time to join our business. As Continental embarks on a new chapter as a dedicated, pure-play tyre company, we are returning to our roots while accelerating our focus on innovation, customer centricity, premium products, and sustainable growth. This transformation creates unique opportunities to influence the future direction of the business, shape our brand story, and play a key role in driving growth across our consumer and commercial tyre portfolios.

You'll have the opportunity to help define how one of the world's most trusted tyre brands connects with customers, partners, and employees, while working on market-leading products, high-profile sponsorships, cutting-edge digital campaigns, and industry-leading customer experiences.

This is more than a marketing role—it's an opportunity to be part of a business transformation, create inspiring customer experiences, build meaningful brand connections, and help write the next chapter in Continental's proud tyre heritage.

If you're a passionate storyteller, strategic thinker, and marketing leader who wants to make a real impact during an exciting period of change and growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Reward Package & Next Steps

We offer a Competitive salary and benefits package including:

Excellent Contributory Pension
Private Health Care
Annual Bonus
Car allowance
Subsidised On site Gym & Canteen
Hybrid Working Pattern (3 days in Office)
Plus many more.....

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you are a bold, innovative and commercially savvy marketing communicator, we would love to hear from you. Apply now.

jobs.title: Senior Video Producer
jobs.description:
About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon
, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.

Alongside our events, we publish research, run a university, and produce content that reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers worldwide. In practice, we're a media house for a technical audience.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Video Producer
to own video across the organization, end to end.

This is a build-it role. We don't have a video function yet. What we have is freelancers, ambition, and an audience that already trusts us. You'll come in and create the system: how we shoot, how we edit, how we publish, and how our YouTube channel grows.

You'll own the craft and the pipeline. That means editing the bulk of our output yourself, but also deciding what camera our founders point at themselves, how their rooms are lit, how their audio is captured, and what "good" looks like before anyone hits record. It means owning our YouTube channel as a channel, with packaging, Shorts, retention, and growth all in scope, rather than treating it as a place to upload finished files.

We're a distributed team, so most of what we make is produced remotely. A few times a year we come together at offsites across Europe and beyond, and you'll turn those into concentrated production windows where we capture a quarter's worth of higher-production content in a few days.

What You'll Do

Own end-to-end video production: concept, shoot setup, edit, post, publish, and performance review.
Define and maintain our remote production standards for cameras, lenses, microphones, lighting, and backgrounds, and set up the team so a home office consistently produces broadcast-credible video.
Coach on-camera talent, including our founders, on framing, audio, pacing, and delivery, and hold the standard once it's set.
Edit the majority of our weekly output across long-form, interview, explainer, event, and short-form content.
Own our YouTube channel: packaging, thumbnails, titles, descriptions, chapters, SEO, and publishing cadence.
Build and run our Shorts strategy as a deliberate format, not as offcuts from long-form.
Analyze channel performance across retention, CTR, watch time, and subscriber growth, and use it to decide what we make next.
Plan and run quarterly production sprints at our in-person offsites, including shot lists, scheduling, and directing local crew where needed.
Capture and repurpose content from PlatformCon and our other events.
Build the systems behind all of this: intake and brief formats, turnaround expectations, asset libraries, templates, and brand kit.
Manage a bench of external animators, editors, and specialists for advanced motion work and high-volume weeks.

What you'll bring

5+ years of professional experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for video production and post-production
Demonstrable ownership of video end to end. You've been the person responsible for the output, not one step in someone else's pipeline.
Expert-level editing skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut, with strong color and audio finishing.
Real command of production fundamentals: camera selection and settings, lens choice, lighting design, and audio capture, including how to get all of it right in a spare bedroom rather than a studio.
Genuine YouTube expertise. You understand how the algorithm actually rewards content, you've packaged videos that outperformed their baseline, and you can explain why a video underperformed beyond "the thumbnail was weak."
A track record with short-form: you know what makes a Short retain, and you've made them work as a format in their own right.
Systems thinking. You document what you build, and you'd rather fix a workflow once than fight it weekly.
Comfort directing people who aren't natural on-camera performers, tactfully and without losing the standard.
Experience briefing and managing freelancers or external production partners.
Native-level English proficiency.
Willingness to travel a few times per year for offsites and events.

Nice to have

Experience producing video for technical or developer audiences, and comfort with the subject matter.
Motion graphics and animation skills (After Effects or similar).
Experience growing a YouTube channel with numbers you can point to.
Podcast production and audio post experience.
Experience running multi-day batch shoots or studio days.
Familiarity with AI-assisted editing and production tooling, and a practical view on where it helps.
Experience working in a startup or scale-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

Why join us?

You'd be the first video hire at an organization that already has the audience, the access, and the credibility, and no one shaping how any of it looks on screen. There's no existing system to inherit or work around. You define it.

You'll have direct access to the people building and running the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, and the freedom to decide how their stories get told. If you want a role where your judgment sets the standard rather than executes someone else's, this is that role.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is hiring a Head of Public Affairs
to lead external communications and public affairs for our government programs. You'll own publicity, announcements, and message coordination with federal and executive-branch communications stakeholders — translating complex, sensitive program work into accurate, approved public narratives.

The Impact You Will Have

Lead public affairs for TRM's government programs — own the external narrative and drive publicity that creates clarity, credibility and engagement around the missions we are supporting,
Own government and agency media relations — build relationships, navigate review and approval cycles, and maintain message discipline across stakeholders.
Position TRM and program leaders as credible voices in public moments where appropriate, with sound judgment about what is said, when, and by whom.
Lead rapid response during reputational, regulatory, or program-related events — drafting statements and coordinating with agency comms leads and TRM Policy/Legal before anything goes public.
Operate with discretion inside approval-gated, confidentiality-heavy environments.

What We're Looking For

8–12+ years in strategic communications / public affairs, with meaningful experience in or alongside government (federal agency, Capitol Hill, or a public-affairs firm serving government clients).
Proven ownership of high-stakes external communications and senior/principal-level positioning — not just supporting a senior leader.
Comfort inside government review, message-clearance, and approval cycles, with strict confidentiality on sensitive work.
Exceptional writing and message framing, and sound judgment in fast-moving, high-sensitivity public moments.
AI-fluent in how modern communications work gets done, with a proactive experimentation mindset.
Based in (or able to be highly present in) Washington, DC.

About The Team

Our core mission is to drive revenue growth by shaping market perception and activating demand through strategic storytelling across and visibility across earned and owned channels.
You will partner closely with Insights, Brand & Content, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Regional Marketing, and the Executive Team.
Core collaboration overlap with ET; flexible hours with expectation of responsiveness to media inquiries

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.

Overview

Crocs is seeking a Creative Director, Partnerships and Collectible
s to lead creative vision and execution across brand collaborations, limited drops, and collectible storytelling.

Reporting to the Vice President, Global Creative, this role defines how Crocs shows up in partnership with other brands, talent, and cultural voices. This leader will shape ideas that balance identities, ensuring every collaboration feels authentic, additive, and unmistakably Crocs without letting one voice dominate the other.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for the full creative expression of partnerships. This includes campaign storytelling across film and photography, packaging and product storytelling, e-commerce, and visual merchandising.

The ideal candidate is both a visionary and a builder. Someone who understands how to create ideas that live across systems, partners, and product while maintaining clarity, craft, and cultural relevance.

The Kind Of Creative Who Thrives Here

You’re curious about culture and how brands intersect within it.
You’re imaginative in how ideas can bring different worlds together.
You understand balance. You know how to hold multiple perspectives and shape work where every voice feels intentional and considered.
You think in systems, not just moments, building ideas that extend across product, packaging, storytelling, and experience.
You care deeply about craft, from campaign storytelling to the smallest detail in a collectible.
You’re comfortable navigating complexity, working across teams, partners, and constraints without losing the idea.
You’re inspired by culture, design, and the unexpected.
At Crocs, we call that Wonderfully Unordinary.

What You'll Do

Lead with vision: Define the creative direction for partnerships and collectibles, ensuring every collaboration feels balanced, intentional, and brand-right
Build ideas in partnership: Develop concepts that bring two brands together in harmony, creating something new without compromising either identity
Own the full expression: Oversee creative across campaigns, film, photography, packaging, e-commerce, and retail environments
Champion storytelling: Translate partnership strategy into compelling narratives that drive cultural relevance and consumer excitement
Design for product and drop culture: Shape how collaborations come to life through packaging, collectibles, and in-hand experiences
Lead and inspire teams: Guide a multidisciplinary team across art direction, design, and copy, setting a high bar for both thinking and execution
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Merchandising, and external collaborators to align creative with business and cultural opportunity
Drive craft and consistency: Ensure all outputs reflect a high level of quality, cohesion, and attention to detail across every touchpoint
Navigate complexity: Manage multiple partners, timelines, and expectations while maintaining creative clarity and momentum
Present with impact: Communicate ideas and creative direction confidently to internal leadership and external partners
Stay culturally attuned: Bring awareness of trends, collaborators, and cultural movements to identify meaningful partnership opportunities
Experiment with new tools: Stay curious and open to innovation — exploring how AI, emerging technology, and evolving creative processes can unlock new ways to tell stories and create at scale

What You'll Bring to the Table

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience
At least 10+ years of experience in creative roles across brand, agency, or in-house teams
At least 3+ years leading and developing creative teams
Strong experience in brand collaborations, partnerships, or cultural marketing
Proven ability to lead work across campaigns, packaging, retail, and digital touchpoints
Expert-level art direction, design, and or copywriting skills
Strong storytelling and concept development abilities
Experience working with external partners, collaborators, and talent
Ability to manage complex projects with multiple collaborators
Excellent presentation and communication skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to craft across all outputs
Understanding of consumer insights, trends, and cultural dynamics

jobs.description:
Job Description

Chicago or Northbrook, Illinois, United States (Hybrid 3 Days a Week On-Site)

At UL Solutions, you’ll have the opportunity to work for a safer world, using your corporate communications experience and expertise to elevate the external profile of a global leader in the testing, inspection, and certification industry.

We are hiring a Corporate Communications Lead, Executive Visibility & Thought Leadership, reporting to the Director of Executive and Business Communications. This role drives proactive external visibility for senior business leaders by translating complex technical topics related to global megatrends (energy transition/electrification, AI/digitalization and sustainability) into high-impact thought leadership, executive positioning and engagement opportunities.

The Corporate Communications Lead will also manage select internal communications for the business, providing strategic counsel and communications support for business- or enterprise-wide change-management and business-transformation programs.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned and versatile communications professional and writer with experience in corporate media relations, executive communications and speechwriting, social media strategies, and internal corporate communications. A journalism background is a plus but not required. In-house corporate communications experience is essential.

This position enables senior leaders to engage effectively with customers, industry, government, and academic audiences across key business verticals. This hybrid role requires working from the office three days per week.

Responsibilities

Lead executive visibility programs for senior business leaders and technical experts, including media placements and speaking engagements aligned to priority verticals.
Develop message architecture and storylines that translate business priorities and technical content into clear, credible external narratives.
Develop executive briefings, talk tracks, interview preparation materials and other assets that ensure leaders are ready, confident and message‑aligned.
Collaborate closely with Corporate Communications’ agency partner to support external thought‑leadership opportunities tied to business priorities.
Partner with contributed‑content team to support development of bylined articles and trade‑media thought leadership.
Coordinate with External Communications to ensure engagements, materials and messaging are consistent with outreach plans and approved guidance.
Use established decision-making and escalation guidelines to determine when activities can proceed and when additional leadership alignment is required.
Track and report on executive visibility activity and outcomes in support of monthly vertical updates.

Qualifications

Proven experience supporting senior leaders (VP/SVP/EVP or equivalent) with executive communications, thought leadership or external visibility programs.
Ability to synthesize complex technical subject matter into concise, externally relevant messages for diverse audiences.
Excellent writing and editing skills across executive communications formats (e.g., speeches, talking points, briefing documents, social media posts, etc.).
Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive topics.
Ability to operate independently in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.
7+ years of corporate communications experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Business, or a related field.

What You’ll Experience Working For ULS

UL Solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. From day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. Our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. We break things, burn things and blow things up. All in the name of safety science.

That’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. It takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. It takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.

This is more than a job. It’s a calling. A passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. As a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.

Everyone here is unique. But we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. Join UL Solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.

Empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. It means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. At UL Solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.

Join UL Solutions to be at the center of safety. To learn more about us and the work we do, visit  UL.com

Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. The estimated salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. This position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary. This position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401K) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. We also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (15 days), holiday including floating holidays (12 days) and sick time off (72 hours).

About Us

A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.

.

ExxonMobil's state-of-the-art campus north of Houston serves as home to its Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses and their associated service groups. The facility opened in 2014 and accommodates more than 10,000 employees and visitors.

Experience in change management, culture-building, and crisis communications.

jobs.title: Director of Communications & PR
jobs.description:
About The Company

About Cleo

At Cleo, we're not just building another fintech app. We're embarking on a mission to fundamentally change humanity's relationship with money. Imagine a world where everyone, regardless of background or income, has access to a hyper-intelligent financial advisor in their pocket. That's the future we're creating.

Cleo is a rare success story: a profitable, fast-growing unicorn with over $380 million in ARR and growing over 2x year-over-year. This isn't just a job; it's a chance to join a team of brilliant, driven individuals who are passionate about making a real difference. We have an exceptionally high bar for talent, seeking individuals who are not only at the top of their field but also embody our culture of collaboration and positive impact.

If you’re driven by complex challenges that push your expertise, the chance to shape something truly transformative, and the potential to share in Cleo’s success as we scale, while growing alongside a company that’s scaling fast, this might be your perfect fit.

Follow us on LinkedIn to keep up to date with new product features and insights from the team.

About The Role

Cleo has done the hard part. The product works. The numbers are real. The mission resonates. The step is to evolve to magnifying our story in the obvious and not so obvious places.

We've built one of the fastest-growing companies in the world -> $300M+ ARR, 500+ people, millions of Americans using Cleo every day. As we enter our next phase of growth, we’re investing intentionally in shaping how the company is understood by investors, media, and the broader tech ecosystems.

We're looking for a PR and communications leader who understands that in fintech, reputation is a growth lever, and that the best PR doesn't look like PR at all. Someone who can shift our narrative from consumer app coverage to tier-1 investor and business press, build our founder's profile as a voice in AI and fintech, and turn our extraordinary consumer traction into the kind of ambient signal that makes investors come to us.

This role reports directly to the SVP, Marketing and works in partnership with the CEO. While fully remote, the ideal candidate is located in the eastern time zone given our team spans London, New York, and California.

Key Responsibilities

Own Cleo's investor-facing narrative

Build and execute a PR strategy that shifts Cleo's coverage from consumer reviews to tier-1 business and investor press. Think: Bloomberg, FT, TechCrunch, Forbes, CNBC
Position Cleo in the same conversation as industry leading companies, and even ahead of them where the story warrants it
Ensure that when an investor or journalist searches Cleo, they find a compelling, consistent story that reflects our actual scale and ambition

Build founder visibility and thought leadership

Develop and execute a content and visibility strategy for our CEO across LinkedIn, podcasts, long-form essays, and speaking stages
Secure appearances on investor and founder-facing platforms. Think along the lines of 20VC, Lenny's Podcast, Money20/20, TechCrunch Disrupt, Sifted Summit
Help craft shareholder-style letters, category commentary, conviction pieces and other kinds of writing that make a founder a voice in the industry, not just a CEO with a product to sell

Turn consumer traction into investor signal

Work with Growth and Brand to surface Cleo's user data, financial health impact, and product momentum as proactive press stories
Build a pipeline of data-led narratives - spending reports, financial health insights, subscriber milestones that generate earned media opportunities

Build and protect Cleo's reputation

Establish Cleo as a named source for journalists covering AI in fintech, personal finance, and consumer technology - not just when we have news
Develop crisis communications protocols appropriate for a regulated financial product at our scale
Build and own proactive relationships with tier-1 journalists

Lead and grow the comms function

Define the team structure, agency relationships, and tooling needed to execute at this level
Set clear goals tied to investor inbound quality, media tier, brand awareness among opinion elites, and founder visibility
Make PR a company-wide habit: work cross-functionally with Growth, Product, Brand, and Leadership to keep the narrative consistent and compounding

What We're Looking For

7+ years in PR, communications, or a combination of both, with a track record of building investor and media reputation for a high-growth tech / fintech company is a must have
Exposure to the US market is necessary for this role, UK and other locations a bonus
Proven experience taking a company through a significant PR inflection point e.g. a fundraising narrative build, pre-IPO profile, or major category repositioning
Experience working directly with a founder or CEO to build their personal brand and media presence
Strong existing relationships with tier-1 business, tech, and fintech journalists
Ability to translate complex product and financial stories into narratives that land with both consumer and institutional audiences
Strategic thinker who can set a multi-quarter narrative arc, not just react to news cycles
Comfortable operating in a high-autonomy environment with limited process and high expectations
Agency and in-house experience both welcome

What do you get for all your hard work?

A competitive compensation package (base + equity) with bi-annual reviews, aligned to our quarterly OKR planning cycles
Work at one of the fastest-growing tech startups, backed by top VC firms, Balderton & EQT Ventures
A clear progression plan. We want you to keep growing. That means trying new things, leading others, challenging the status quo and owning your impact. Always with our complete support
Flexibility. We can't fight for the world's financial health if we're not healthy ourselves. We work with everyone to make sure they have the balance they need to do their best work
Work where you work best. We're a globally distributed team. Our US team works fully remotely, but we host virtual socials. This role will also offer the opportunity to travel to the London HQ.

Other Benefits

Company-wide performance reviews every 6 months
Generous pay increases for high-performing team members
Equity top-ups for team members getting promoted
15 days annual leave a year + 5 additional floating flexible days + public holidays (+ an additional day for every year you spend at Cleo)
1 extra day a year for learning and 1 extra day for volunteering
401k matching
Medical Insurance, Dental and Vision care
Generous Parental Leave
1 month paid sabbatical after 4 years at Cleo
Regular socials and activities, online and in-person
We'll pay for your OpenAI subscription
Online mental health support via Spill
And many more!

Welcoming Everyone

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Compensation range

United States: $200,000 - $250,000 gross annually*
Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process
Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

jobs.title: Chief Development and Communications Officer
jobs.description:
SUMMARY DESCRIPTION:

Reporting to the CEO, the Chief Development and Communications Officer (CDCO), serves as a key leadership team member and an active participant in making strategic decisions affecting Sheltering Arms. In partnership with the CEO, this position is responsible for all fundraising and resource development, including annual giving, major gifts, planned giving, capital campaigns, special events, in-kind and volunteer resources. The successful candidate will help forge new relationships to build Sheltering Arms’ visibility, impact and financial resources.

S/he will expand and diversify Sheltering Arms’ donor base pipeline and work closely with other team members to secure funding for new initiatives. In addition, the CDCO will work closely with the Board of Directors and support Board members as they take on a more active fundraising role.

It is expected that the amount raised by Sheltering Arms will increase in future years as the CDCO, systematically and effectively strengthens the organization’s overall fundraising capacity. The CDCO will drive a fundraising strategy to increase fundraising each year from a baseline of $4 million in the first year.

The CDCO will also oversee all external communications, including public relations and marketing.

PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Support and partner with the CEO and Board members on all major fundraising initiatives.
Actively work with the President and CEO and senior staff to develop and implement a comprehensive development strategy to include individuals, corporate, foundation, government grants, and events.
Develop, maintain and build fundraising database; generate fundraising reports for Board and accounting.
Develop and implement system for donor and volunteer recognition, including timely thank you notes that comply to IRS standards, reports as required by funders and pledge due notices.
Collaborate with the CFO to develop and implement Sheltering Arms’ financial strategy.
Oversee research funding sources and trends, with foresight, to help position Sheltering Arms ahead of major funding changes or trends.
Research new potential sources of support and implement strategies for introducing them to Sheltering Arms.
Promote Sheltering Arms as its representative to the community in networking opportunities and presentations reaching target audiences.
Plan and execute the annual signature fundraiser event.
Develop and execute an annual resource development plan, including major gifts, annual campaign, Board campaign, and special events.
Develop and execute an annual marketing and communication plan.
Develop and implement direct mail campaign, Board campaign, and other face-to-face, print, and online solicitations of individual donor base to support annual operating budget.
Develop and publish print materials for external communication, including newsletter, annual report, advertisements, promotional literature, stationery, displays, brochures, etc.
Develop, promote, and manage planned giving program.
Develop, promote, and manage agency-wide special events.
Create and implement marketing strategies and campaigns to increase enrollment of tuition paying families.
Research feasibility, develop strategies, and implement an action plan for capital, endowment, and other special campaigns.

KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES, AND SKILLS:

Proficient in all Microsoft applications; Knowledge of Raiser’s Edge.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills, including public speaking and presentation skills.
Ability to influence and engage a wide range of donors and build long-term relationships.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervising personnel, co-workers, representatives from all levels of government, civic organizations, business professionals and general public.
Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail; ability to work in a high-paced environment managing multiple projects and deadlines.
Flexible and adaptive style; a leader who can positively impact both strategic and tactical fundraising initiatives.
Works independently while understanding the necessity for communicating and coordinating work efforts with other employees and departments.
Strong research skills.
High energy and passion for Sheltering Arms’ mission is essential.
Professional level of confidentiality in handling employee information.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor's Degree (Master’s preferred) in Nonprofit Management, Communications or related field; certifications in business, marketing and/or fund raising desirable.
Minimum of 7 years professional fundraising experience is required in a nonprofit organization, preferably in the fields of early childhood education or education services.
Tangible experience of having expanded and cultivated existing donor relationships over time.
Demonstrated success in development function (managing and forging relationships with multiple donor sources).
Familiarity with metro Atlanta business community and high net worth individuals a plus.

CERTIFICATE AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS:

Possess a valid Georgia Driver’s License with current driving insurance, no record of driver caused accidents, no traffic violations within last 3 years;

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Must be able to lift 30 lbs. without assistance; 50 lbs. with assistance. Position requires the ability to reach with hands and arms as well as to use hands to finger, handle or feel. Ability to talk and hear as well as stand, walk, and sit required. Occasional need to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

Willingness and ability to travel to multiple Sheltering Arms sites
Must pass a criminal background check and also a drug screen

The employee will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other related duties as assigned by leadership.
